functions.name: addSqlPackage
functions.description: Adds a SQL Server Database Project resource from a NuGet package.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.
functions.signature: addSqlPackage(name: string, packageId: string, version: string): SqlProjectResource

parameters.name: packageId
parameters.description: ID of the NuGet package containing the DACPAC.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Exact NuGet package version, including any prerelease label.

functions.name: addSqlProject
functions.description: Adds a SQL Server Database Project resource to the application.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.

functions.name: addSqlProjectFromPath
functions.description: Adds a SQL Server Database Project resource from a project file path.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.
functions.signature: addSqlProjectFromPath(name: string, projectPath: string, configuration?: string): SqlProjectResource

parameters.name: projectPath
parameters.description: Path to the SQL Server Database project, relative to the AppHost directory or absolute.

parameters.name: configuration
parameters.description: MSBuild configuration used to build the project and resolve its output. Defaults to `Debug`.

functions.name: dacDeployOptionsPath
functions.description: Gets the configured path to the deployment options publish profile.

functions.name: dacpacPath
functions.description: Gets the configured path to the .dacpac file.

functions.name: skipWhenDeployed
functions.description: Gets a value indicating whether deployment should be skipped when the dacpac has already been deployed.

functions.name: withConnectionReference
functions.description: Publishes the SQL Server database project to a connection string resource.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: An `IResourceBuilder`1` representing the target `IResourceWithConnectionString` to publish the SQL Server Database project to.

functions.name: withDacDeployOptions
functions.description: Sets the publish profile path used for DAC deployment options.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.

parameters.name: optionsPath
parameters.description: Path to the publish profile xml file

functions.name: withDacpac
functions.description: Specifies the path to the .dacpac file.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.

parameters.name: dacpacPath
parameters.description: Path to the .dacpac file, or a path relative to a NuGet package for a resource created by `AddSqlPackage`.

functions.name: withReference
functions.description: Publishes the SQL Server database project to a SQL Server database resource.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: An `IResourceBuilder`1` representing the target `SqlServerDatabaseResource` to publish the SQL Server Database project to.

functions.name: withSkipWhenDeployed
functions.description: Specifies that .dacpac deployment should be skipped if metadata in the target database indicates that the .dacpac has already been deployed in its current state.
functions.returns: An `IResourceBuilder`1` that can be used to further customize the resource.
